title: The ordinary tensor evaluation composite on unit pure tensors
statement: For arbitrary unbounded sequence complexes P and Q, the unit-preserving ordinary evaluation mate d of [lem-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-evaluation-unit] and the generator-normalized sequence tensor comparison of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations] satisfy this section formula: apply evaluated sequence tensor comparison, the X evaluation tensor comparison and the tensor of d on the two factors to the evaluated sequence unit of a total pure tensor x tensor y. The result is the finite total tensor generator of the two intrinsic finite inverse-image units of the evaluated x and y. The formula holds for every summand degree p+q=i, every pro-etale object, and all input sections.

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product, final ordinary total-complex comparison; Tags 0941 and 03D2 for sequence evaluation and the ordinary adjunction units.

proof.text: Evaluation preserves the chosen section transports. The normalization of the sequence total tensor comparison sends the sequence unit of a total pure generator to the tensor of the two sequence units.

The generator normalization of the X evaluation tensor comparison transports this to the finite pure generator. Functoriality of total pure generators applies d to its two factors, and the evaluation-unit formula identifies the resulting sections with the intrinsic units.

        CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ ⥤

      (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y)) (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y)

        CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E X n) ℤ ⥤

      (ProEt.topology X) (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)

    (z.f i).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
      ((w.f i).val.app _ (((W.map b).f i).val.app _
        (coefficientEvaluationSection l E X
          ((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).obj ((tY.obj (P, Q)).X i)) n
          (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
          (((pullbackTensorSequenceAdjunction l E f).unit.app
            ((tY.obj (P, Q)).X i)).val.app (op (n, U)) sg)))) =
    coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology X)
      (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n) (G.obj (V.obj P)) (G.obj (V.obj Q))
      p q i hpq (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
      (((sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f

          ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).obj (P.X p))).val.app (op U)
